title: Rank, Don't Regress: A 279M Text Ranker Beats 2B and 7B VLMs on Referential Urdu GUI Grounding
why: DOM-candidate text ranker for Urdu mobile-web GUI grounding; click is the selected element's box centre, vs VLM coordinate regression.
mechanism: Replaces screenshot coordinate regression with a 279M mDeBERTa-v3-base cross-encoder over page DOM candidates; the click point is the chosen element's box centre.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: frozen 304-instruction test from six Urdu news sites (149 referential); point-in-box accuracy vs UI-TARS-2B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and a same-scale coordinate-regression control.

title: Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities
why: Calibrated System-One decision models pick a browser agent's next step on web pages and complete live browsing tasks.
mechanism: Adds a calibrated non-generative decision head (and a web-specialized Pro-C-Web variant) that selects the next browser-agent step on page documents in one forward pass.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 19 held-out test sets; Beveridge-Pro-C-Web next-step accuracy on web pages from unseen site types, plus live browsing task completion, against a commercial System One API and five general LLMs.
